seo.title: Valencia Dentistry | Dentist in Valencia, Santa Clarita

sections.heading: Meet Dr. Nuriel Lavi, DDS

image.alt: Dr. Nuriel Lavi, DDS, lead dentist at Valencia Dentistry

body: Dr. Lavi leads Valencia Dentistry on Tourney Road. He and the team listen before recommending anything.

His plans start with your long-term health and your comfort: modern imaging, biocompatible materials, and prevention before quick fixes. You get plain explanations, honest priorities and an unhurried visit.
